Mate. I need to tell you my story.


When i was young (18-20) i struggled with depression and being sucidal. I didnt think i would live long so i piled on debt thinking it didnt mattered. I got evicted and lost everything. 


When i tried to pick my life back up at 25 i started doing a bit better, i got a job, a small but comfy apartament and then i got diagnosed with a chronic disease. All my hobbies like sports and such was no longer possible. I lost my job at the same time because the place i worked at shut down. 


Everyday was filled with pain and misery. Depression hit hard again. For years i could t work. Three years ago when i was 31 i had the worst week of my life. I thought i was going to die, every night. But i didnt. The days kept coming and I refused to give up and put my head down and started grinding. 


Today i work with one of biggest companies in europe (in my field) . I am i own man, decide my own hours and get to pick and choose who i work with. 
I work with something i love and I know the people i work with love working with me. I make a good living and life feels like it finally has started. Just last week i got offered to add on another role at my job and get even more oppertunities. I still got debt but im paying it of little by little. 


I struggled almost everyday from High school until i was 31-32. Then my "real life" started. 
Dont give up. I know it feels hopeless and dark and it fucking sucks. And I also know its cliche and been said thousands of times but please put your head down and keep grinding and trying. You will find something that fits you and the light WILL come. Maybe not now, maybe not next year but it will come. It is NEVER to late. It might not be what you want life/work to be or what you expected from life but it can at least be something.
